PDF Compressor

Shrink a PDF's file size by re-rendering its pages as compressed images. Choose Low, Medium or High quality and compare sizes before downloading.

Compress PDF

Reduce a PDF's file size by re-rendering its pages as compressed images.

Please note: this re-renders pages as compressed images — great for image-heavy PDFs; text will no longer be selectable in the output.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser. If your PDF is mostly text, re-rendering may not shrink it much.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file to compress.
  2. Pick a quality level: Low (smallest file), Medium, or High (best detail).
  3. Click "Compress PDF" and wait for the progress bar to finish.
  4. Compare the original and compressed sizes, then download the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the compression work?

Each page is rendered to an image and saved as a JPEG at your chosen quality. Lower quality means a smaller file; higher quality keeps more detail.

Will text still be selectable in the compressed PDF?

Yes — output pages are images, so text can no longer be selected or searched. It works best on image-heavy PDFs such as scans and photo documents.

Is my file sent to a server?

Nothing is uploaded. The whole process — rendering, compressing and rebuilding — runs in your browser.
